title: Pipeline rupture
goal: Show quantified causes of a full-bore buried-pipeline rupture.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Full-bore pipeline rupture is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows overpressure and material weakness at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates corrosion, weld defect, and third-party impact branches.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/faulttree/ideal.svg (sha256 7bffbe71b8bd), source sha256 43534aa2989c. Independent top-down fault tree, exact boolean-state enumeration and minimal cut-set extraction, slate event boxes, green AND/OR/INHIBIT gates, blue probabilities. Output stems and the single-child inhibit connection corrected following visual inspection; all declared conditions and basic probabilities retained. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
